comment: BT-5014: schema of ~/.beamtalk/workspaces/<id>/metadata.json, shared by the Rust CLI (storage.rs), the Erlang writer (beamtalk_workspace_meta) and the desktop broker (discovery.rs). Each writer owns a set of keys and must preserve every key it does not own. Rust half: crates/beamtalk-cli/src/commands/workspace/storage.rs tests; broker half: crates/beamtalk-desktop-broker/src/discovery.rs tests; Erlang half: beamtalk_workspace_meta_tests.
